what: A six-voice polysynth inspired by the Juno-106: one DCO a voice with saw, pulse/PWM, sub and noise, a high-pass, a resonant four-pole low-pass, one ADSR, an LFO with delay and a stereo chorus, with 128 patches, chord memory and an arpeggiator. Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by Roland or M-VAVE.
author: Fergus
